toolkit.name: Mailchimp
toolkit.description: Mailchimp is an email marketing and automation platform providing campaign templates, audience segmentation, and performance analytics to drive engagement and conversions

tools.name: Add campaign
tools.description: Create a new Mailchimp campaign.

type.title: Type
type.description: There are four types of [campaigns](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-campaigns/) you can create in Mailchimp. A/B Split campaigns have been deprecated and variate campaigns should be used instead.

content_type.title: ContentTypeEnm
content_type.description: How the campaign"s content is put together. The old drag and drop editor uses "template" while the new editor uses "multichannel". Defaults to template.

tracking__opens.title: Tracking  Opens
tracking__opens.description: Whether to [track opens](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-open-tracking/). Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

settings__to__name.title: Settings  To  Name
settings__to__name.description: The campaign"s custom "To" name. Typically the first name [audience field](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-merge-tags/).

settings__reply__to.title: Settings  Reply  To
settings__reply__to.description: The reply-to email address for the campaign. Note: while this field is not required for campaign creation, it is required for sending.

social__card__title.title: Social  Card  Title
social__card__title.description: The title for the card. Typically the subject line of the campaign.

tracking__clicktale.title: Tracking  Clicktale
tracking__clicktale.description: The custom slug for [ClickTale](https://mailchimp.com/help/additional-tracking-options-for-campaigns/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

rss__opts__feed__url.title: Rss  Opts  Feed  Url
rss__opts__feed__url.description: The URL for the RSS feed.

rss__opts__frequency.title: FrequencyEnm
rss__opts__frequency.description: The frequency of the RSS Campaign.

settings__folder__id.title: Settings  Folder  Id
settings__folder__id.description: If the campaign is listed in a folder, the id for that folder.

settings__from__name.title: Settings  From  Name
settings__from__name.description: The "from" name on the campaign (not an email address).

settings__auto__tweet.title: Settings  Auto  Tweet
settings__auto__tweet.description: Automatically tweet a link to the [campaign archive](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-email-campaign-archives-and-pages/) page when the campaign is sent.

settings__inline__css.title: Settings  Inline  Css
settings__inline__css.description: Automatically inline the CSS included with the campaign content.

settings__authenticate.title: Settings  Authenticate
settings__authenticate.description: Whether Mailchimp [authenticated](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-email-authentication/) the campaign. Defaults to `true`.

settings__auto__footer.title: Settings  Auto  Footer
settings__auto__footer.description: Automatically append Mailchimp"s [default footer](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-campaign-footers/) to the campaign.

settings__fb__comments.title: Settings  Fb  Comments
settings__fb__comments.description: Allows Facebook comments on the campaign (also force-enables the Campaign Archive toolbar). Defaults to `true`.

settings__template__id.title: Settings  Template  Id
settings__template__id.description: The id of the template to use.

tracking__html__clicks.title: Tracking  Html  Clicks
tracking__html__clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

tracking__text__clicks.title: Tracking  Text  Clicks
tracking__text__clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

settings__preview__text.title: Settings  Preview  Text
settings__preview__text.description: The preview text for the campaign.

settings__subject__line.title: Settings  Subject  Line
settings__subject__line.description: The subject line for the campaign.

settings__auto__fb__post.title: Settings  Auto  Fb  Post
settings__auto__fb__post.description: An array of [Facebook](https://mailchimp.com/help/connect-or-disconnect-the-facebook-integration/) page ids to auto-post to.

social__card__image__url.title: Social  Card  Image  Url
social__card__image__url.description: The url for the header image for the card.

tracking__capsule__notes.title: Tracking  Capsule  Notes
tracking__capsule__notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

rss__opts__schedule__hour.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Hour
rss__opts__schedule__hour.description: The hour to send the campaign in local time. Acceptable hours are 0-23. For example, "4" would be 4am in [your account"s default time zone](https://mailchimp.com/help/set-account-defaults/).

social__card__description.title: Social  Card  Description
social__card__description.description: A short summary of the campaign to display.

settings__use__conversation.title: Settings  Use  Conversation
settings__use__conversation.description: Use Mailchimp Conversation feature to manage out-of-office replies.

tracking__google__analytics.title: Tracking  Google  Analytics
tracking__google__analytics.description: The custom slug for [Google Analytics](https://mailchimp.com/help/integrate-google-analytics-with-mailchimp/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

tracking__salesforce__notes.title: Tracking  Salesforce  Notes
tracking__salesforce__notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

variate__settings__test__size.title: Variate  Settings  Test  Size
variate__settings__test__size.description: The percentage of recipients to send the test combinations to, must be a value between 10 and 100.

variate__settings__wait__time.title: Variate  Settings  Wait  Time
variate__settings__wait__time.description: The number of minutes to wait before choosing the winning campaign. The value of wait_time must be greater than 0 and in whole hours, specified in minutes.

rss__opts__constrain__rss__img.title: Rss  Opts  Constrain  Rss  Img
rss__opts__constrain__rss__img.description: Whether to add CSS to images in the RSS feed to constrain their width in campaigns.

tracking__salesforce__campaign.title: Tracking  Salesforce  Campaign
tracking__salesforce__campaign.description: Create a campaign in a connected Salesforce account.

variate__settings__from__names.title: Variate  Settings  From  Names
variate__settings__from__names.description: The possible from names. The number of from_names provided must match the number of reply_to_addresses. If no from_names are provided, settings.from_name will be used.

variate__settings__send__times.title: Variate  Settings  Send  Times
variate__settings__send__times.description: The possible send times to test. The times provided should be in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. If send_times are provided to test, the test_size will be set to 100% and winner_criteria will be ignored.

variate__settings__subject__lines.title: Variate  Settings  Subject  Lines
variate__settings__subject__lines.description: The possible subject lines to test. If no subject lines are provided, settings.subject_line will be used.

variate__settings__winner__criteria.title: WinnerCriteriaEnm
variate__settings__winner__criteria.description: The combination that performs the best. This may be determined automatically by click rate, open rate, or total revenue -- or you may choose manually based on the reporting data you find the most valuable. For Multivariate Campaigns testing send_time, winner_criteria is ignored. For Multivariate Campaigns with "manual" as the winner_criteria, the winner must be chosen in the Mailchimp web application.

recipients__segment__opts__conditions.title: Recipients  Segment  Opts  Conditions
recipients__segment__opts__conditions.description: Segment match conditions. There are multiple possible types, see the [condition types documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/alternative-schemas/#segment-condition-schemas).

rss__opts__schedule__weekly__send__day.title: WeeklySendDayEnm
rss__opts__schedule__weekly__send__day.description: The day of the week to send a weekly RSS Campaign.

variate__settings__reply__to__addresses.title: Variate  Settings  Reply  To  Addresses
variate__settings__reply__to__addresses.description: The possible reply-to addresses. The number of reply_to_addresses provided must match the number of from_names. If no reply_to_addresses are provided, settings.reply_to will be used.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__friday.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Friday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__friday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Fridays.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__monday.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Monday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__monday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Mondays.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__sunday.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Sunday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__sunday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Sundays.

rss__opts__schedule__monthly__send__date.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Monthly  Send  Date
rss__opts__schedule__monthly__send__date.description: The day of the month to send a monthly RSS Campaign. Acceptable days are 0-31, where "0" is always the last day of a month. Months with fewer than the selected number of days will not have an RSS campaign sent out that day. For example, RSS Campaigns set to send on the 30th will not go out in February.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__tuesda.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Tuesday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__tuesda.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Tuesdays.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__saturd.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Saturday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__saturd.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Saturdays.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__thursd.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Thursday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__thursd.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Thursdays.

rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__wednes.title: Rss  Opts  Schedule  Daily  Send  Wednesday
rss__opts__schedule__daily__send__wednes.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Wednesdays.

recipients__segment__opts__saved__segmen.title: Recipients  Segment  Opts  Saved  Segment  Id
recipients__segment__opts__saved__segmen.description: The id for an existing saved segment.

tools.name: Add Campaign Feedback
tools.description: Add feedback on a specific Mailchimp campaign. Use this to post comments, notes, or feedback while collaborating on a campaign with your team. The feedback can be associated with a specific content block or applied to the campaign as a whole.

message.title: Message
message.description: The content of the feedback message. This is the text of the feedback comment.

block_id.title: Block Id
block_id.description: The block ID for the editable block that the feedback addresses. Optional - omit if providing general feedback on the campaign.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique ID for the campaign. You can get this from the List Campaigns endpoint or when creating a campaign.

is_complete.title: Is Complete
is_complete.description: Whether the feedback item is complete. Set to true to mark as resolved, false otherwise. Defaults to false if not provided.

tools.name: Add campaign folder
tools.description: Create a new campaign folder to organize email campaigns in Mailchimp. Campaign folders help organize your email marketing campaigns into logical groups. Returns the created folder's ID, name, and initial campaign count (0).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for the new campaign folder. This is used to organize campaigns in the Mailchimp interface.

tools.name: Add contact to audience
tools.description: Tool to create a new omni-channel contact in a Mailchimp audience. Use when adding contacts with email and/or SMS channels to an audience.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: An array of tag names to add to the contact. This operation is append-only; existing tags will be preserved, and only new tags from this array will be added.

language.title: Language
language.description: The subscriber's language preference as a two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr').

audience_id.title: Audience Id
audience_id.description: The unique ID for the audience. Get this from the Mailchimp account or via the list audiences endpoint.

sms_channel.title: SmsChannel

sms_phone.title: Sms Phone
sms_phone.description: SMS phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +14045550102 for US numbers).

marketing_consent.title: Marketing Consent

status.title: Status
status.description: Marketing consent status. Use 'consented' for users who have given consent, 'denied' for those who have not, 'unknown' if consent status is unclear, or 'confirmed' for double opt-in confirmed consent.

marketing_consent.description: A contact's current consent status for SMS marketing communications.

sms_channel.description: SMS channel details for a contact.

merge_fields.title: Merge Fields
merge_fields.description: A dictionary of merge fields where the keys are the merge tags (like FNAME, LNAME). Values are strings representing the field values. See the Merge Fields documentation for more about the structure.

email_channel.title: EmailChannel

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address for the contact. Must be a valid email format.

marketing_consent.title: Marketing Consent

status.title: Status
status.description: Marketing consent status. Use 'consented' for users who have given consent, 'denied' for those who have not, 'unknown' if consent status is unclear, or 'confirmed' for double opt-in confirmed consent.

marketing_consent.description: A contact's current consent status for email marketing communications.

email_channel.description: Email channel details for a contact.

tools.name: Add member note
tools.description: Add a new note for a specific subscriber in a Mailchimp list (audience). Notes are useful for keeping internal records about contacts, such as conversation history, preferences, or other relevant information.

note.title: Note
note.description: The content of the note to add to the member. Note length is limited to 1,000 characters.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: The unique ID for the list (audience).

subscriber_hash.title: Subscriber Hash
subscriber_hash.description: The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member's email address. Alternatively, you can provide the member's email address or contact_id directly.

tools.name: Add template
tools.description: Create a new email template in the Mailchimp account. Templates can be used to create consistent email campaigns. Only Classic (HTML) templates are supported through this API endpoint. The template HTML can include Mailchimp merge tags (e.g., *|FNAME|*) for personalization.

html.title: Html
html.description:
The raw HTML content for the template. Supports Mailchimp Template Language for dynamic content. Must be valid HTML. Example: '

Hello *|FNAME|*

'

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the template. Must be unique within the account.

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to store the template in. If not provided, the template will not be assigned to any folder.

tools.name: Add Template Folder
tools.description: Create a new template folder in Mailchimp. Template folders help organize your email templates. Use this action to create a new folder, then add templates to it using the folder's ID.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the template folder. This will be used to organize your templates within Mailchimp.

tools.name: Get audience contacts
tools.description: Tool to get a list of omni-channel contacts for a given audience. Use when you need to retrieve contacts from a Mailchimp audience with optional filtering and pagination.

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Paginate through a collection of records by setting the cursor parameter to a next_cursor attribute returned by a previous request. Default value fetches the first page of results.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

audience_id.title: Audience Id
audience_id.description: The unique ID for the audience.

created_since.title: Created Since
created_since.description: Restricts the response to contacts created after the specified time (exclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

updated_since.title: Updated Since
updated_since.description: Restricts the response to contacts updated after the specified time (exclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

created_before.title: Created Before
created_before.description: Restricts the response to contacts created at or before the specified time (inclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

updated_before.title: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Restricts the response to contacts updated at or before the specified time (inclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

tools.name: Get audience contact detail
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific omni-channel contact from a Mailchimp audience by their ID or channel hash. Use when you need detailed information about a contact including email/SMS channels, merge fields, tags, and subscription status.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

contact_id.title: Contact Id
contact_id.description: A unique identifier for the contact, which can be a Mailchimp contact ID or a channel hash. A channel hash must follow the format email:[md5_hash] (where the hash is the MD5 of the lowercased email address) or sms:[sha256_hash] (where the hash is the SHA256 of the E.164-formatted phone number).

audience_id.title: Audience Id
audience_id.description: The unique ID for the audience.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

tools.name: Get campaign content
tools.description: Get the HTML and plain-text content for a campaign.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique id for the campaign.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

tools.name: Get campaign info
tools.description: Get information about a specific campaign.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Example: ['id', 'status', 'settings.title', 'recipients.list_id']. If not specified, all fields are returned.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique id for the campaign.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A list of fields to exclude from the response. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Example: ['_links', 'tracking']. Cannot be used together with 'fields'.

include_resend_shortcut_eligibility.title: Include Resend Shortcut Eligibility
include_resend_shortcut_eligibility.description: Return the `resend_shortcut_eligibility` field in the response, which tells you if the campaign is eligible for the various Campaign Resend Shortcuts offered.

tools.name: Get campaign report
tools.description: Retrieve detailed performance report for a Mailchimp campaign. Returns analytics including email delivery stats (sent, bounced), engagement metrics (opens, clicks), and e-commerce data (orders, revenue). Works for both sent campaigns (with actual data) and draft campaigns (returns zeros).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation (e.g., 'opens.opens_total,clicks.click_rate').

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique ID of the sent campaign to retrieve the report for.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation (e.g., 'industry_stats,timeseries').

tools.name: Get list info
tools.description: Get information about a specific list in your Mailchimp account. Results include list members who have signed up but haven't confirmed their subscription yet and unsubscribed or cleaned.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: The unique ID for the list.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

include_total_contacts.title: Include Total Contacts
include_total_contacts.description: Return the total_contacts field in the stats response, which contains an approximate count of all contacts in any state.

tools.name: Get lists info
tools.description: Get information about all lists in the account.

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

email.title: Email
email.description: Restrict results to lists that include a specific subscriber"s email address.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

sort_dir.title: SortDirEnm
sort_dir.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

sort_field.title: SortFieldEnm
sort_field.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

since_date_created.title: Since Date Created
since_date_created.description: Restrict results to lists created after the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_date_created.title: Before Date Created
before_date_created.description: Restrict response to lists created before the set date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

has_ecommerce_store.title: Has Ecommerce Store
has_ecommerce_store.description: Restrict results to lists that contain an active, connected, undeleted ecommerce store.

include_total_contacts.title: Include Total Contacts
include_total_contacts.description: Return the total_contacts field in the stats response, which contains an approximate count of all contacts in any state.

since_campaign_last_sent.title: Since Campaign Last Sent
since_campaign_last_sent.description: Restrict results to lists created after the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_campaign_last_sent.title: Before Campaign Last Sent
before_campaign_last_sent.description: Restrict results to lists created before the last campaign send date. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

tools.name: Get member info
tools.description: Get information about a specific list member, including a currently subscribed, unsubscribed, or bounced member.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields to return. Can be a list or comma-separated string. Use field names for top-level fields (e.g., 'email_address', 'status') or entire sub-objects (e.g., 'merge_fields'). Use dot notation for specific nested fields (e.g., 'merge_fields.FNAME'). Example: ['email_address', 'status', 'merge_fields'] or 'email_address,status,merge_fields'.

list_id.title: List Id
list_id.description: The unique ID for the list (audience). Can be found via the lists endpoint.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: Fields to exclude. Can be a list or comma-separated string. Use field names for top-level fields or sub-objects (e.g., '_links', 'location'). Use dot notation for nested fields. Example: ['_links', 'location'] or '_links,location'.

subscriber_hash.title: Subscriber Hash
subscriber_hash.description: The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member's email address. This endpoint also accepts the member's email address directly or their contact_id.

tools.name: Get template info
tools.description: Get information about a specific template.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Example: 'id,name,type' or 'id,name,thumbnail'.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: The unique id for the template. Can be obtained from the list_templates action.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation. Example: '_links' to exclude HATEOAS links.

tools.name: Get API Root and Account Info
tools.description: Get Mailchimp account details and links to all available API resources. Returns account information including account ID, name, email, contact details, pricing plan, and subscriber count, along with navigation links to other API endpoints like lists, campaigns, automations, templates, and more.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: List of fields to include in the response. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g., 'contact.company'). Available fields include: account_id, account_name, email, first_name, last_name, username, role, member_since, pricing_plan_type, account_timezone, contact, total_subscribers, _links.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: List of fields to exclude from the response. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g., 'contact.company'). Commonly excluded: _links (to reduce response size).

tools.name: List automations
tools.description: Get a summary of an account's classic automations.

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

status.title: StatusEnm
status.description: Restrict the results to automations with the specified status.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

since_start_time.title: Since Start Time
since_start_time.description: Restrict the response to automations started after this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_start_time.title: Before Start Time
before_start_time.description: Restrict the response to automations started before this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

since_create_time.title: Since Create Time
since_create_time.description: Restrict the response to automations created after this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

before_create_time.title: Before Create Time
before_create_time.description: Restrict the response to automations created before this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

tools.name: List campaign feedback
tools.description: Get team feedback while you're working together on a Mailchimp campaign.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A list of fields to include in the response. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g., 'feedback.message', 'feedback.feedback_id', 'total_items'). If not specified, all fields are returned.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique identifier for the campaign. This is a 10-character alphanumeric string (e.g., 'cdf16ea7a1'). You can obtain campaign IDs from the list campaigns action.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A list of fields to exclude from the response. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g., 'feedback._links', '_links'). Useful for reducing response size.

tools.name: List campaign folders
tools.description: Get all folders used to organize campaigns.

count.title: Count
count.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this it the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

exclude_fields.title: Exclude Fields
exclude_fields.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

tools.name: List campaign reports
tools.description: Retrieve analytics reports for sent email campaigns. Returns performance metrics including opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, and e-commerce data for campaigns that have been sent.

type.title: TypeEnm
type.description: Filter by campaign type. Options: 'regular' (standard email), 'plaintext' (text-only), 'absplit' (A/B test), 'rss' (RSS-driven), 'variate' (multivariate test).

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of campaign reports to return per page. Default: 10, Maximum: 1000.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: List of fields to include in response (e.g., ['reports.id', 'reports.campaign_title', 'total_items']). Use dot notation for nested fields.

offset.title: Offset

tools.name: Send campaign
tools.description: Send a Mailchimp campaign immediately. For RSS Campaigns, the campaign will send according to its schedule. All other campaign types (regular, plaintext, variate) will send immediately upon calling this endpoint. Prerequisites: - Campaign must be in 'save' (draft) status - Campaign must have a valid audience (list_id) with at least one recipient - Campaign must have a subject line, from name, and verified from email address - Campaign must have content (HTML or plain text) - The sending account must be in good standing (verified, not disabled) On success, returns HTTP 204 No Content. The campaign status will change to 'sending' and then 'sent' once all emails are delivered.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: The unique id for the campaign to send. The campaign must be in 'save' status and pass all send-checklist requirements (valid audience, subject line, from name, verified from email domain, and content). Use GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/send-checklist to verify the campaign is ready before sending.
